content:
The current population of the United States is around 333 million people as of 2022.

Some more details:

- According to the U.S. Census Bureau, the estimated population of the United States as of July 1, 2022 was 333,285,800.

- This makes the United States the third most populous country in the world, after China and India.

- The population has been steadily growing over time, with the U.S. Census Bureau reporting growth of around 0.1% per year recently.

- The most populous U.S. state is California, with over 39 million residents. Other highly populated states include Texas, Florida, New York, and Pennsylvania.

So in summary, the current estimated population of the USA is approximately 333 million people as of 2022.
